texts.fortiguard-psirt:https://fortiguard.fort:
Linux kernel RCE CVE-2026-98432
CVSSv3 Score:
9.8
CVE-2026-98432:ipv4: free inet_opt and ireq_opt after an RCU grace period tcp_v4_syn_recv_sock() transfers ownership of ireq->ireq_opt to the child socket (newinet->inet_opt) without copying it. Another cpu can concurrently process a retransmitted SYN for the same request socket, and send a SYNACK from tcp_check_req(). tcp_v4_send_synack() and inet_csk_route_req() read ireq->ireq_opt under rcu_read_lock() only, and ip_build_and_send_pkt() and ip_options_build() then read opt->optlen twice. Note that the SYNACK timer itself is not an issue: it holds a reference on its request socket, and inet_csk_reqsk_queue_drop() calls timer_delete_sync() before the child can be freed. Since commit 079096f103fa ("tcp/dccp: install syn_recv requests into ehash table"), request sockets are processed without holding the listener lock, so nothing prevents the child socket from being freed while the SYNACK is still being built. TCP child sockets do not have SOCK_RCU_FREE, and inet_sock_destruct() frees inet_opt with a plain kfree(), leading to a use-after-free in ip_options_build(). A similar issue exists with request socket migration (net.ipv4.tcp_migrate_req=1, or a BPF_SK_REUSEPORT_SELECT_OR_MIGRATE program). reqsk_timer_handler() clones the request socket with inet_reqsk_clone(), so that the old request socket and its clone share the same ireq_opt, then reqsk_migrate_reset() clears the pointer in the old one. Another cpu holding a reference on the old request socket can still be using these options (sending a SYNACK, or creating a child in tcp_v4_syn_recv_sock()) when the clone is freed, and tcp_v4_reqsk_destructor() also uses a plain kfree(). Readers already use RCU, and other paths replacing inet_opt (do_ip_setsockopt(), cipso_v4_sock_setattr()...) already use kfree_rcu(). Use kfree_rcu() in inet_sock_destruct() and tcp_v4_reqsk_destructor() as well. IPv6 is not affected by the first issue, because tcp_v6_syn_recv_sock() duplicates the options. tcp_v6_reqsk_destructor() has the same migration issue with ipv6_opt, which is only set by CALIPSO. This will be addressed in a separate patch.

Linux Kernel: Mehrere Schwachstellen
Ein Angreifer kann mehrere Schwachstellen im Linux Kernel ausnutzen, um einen Denial of Service Angriff durchzuführen oder Root-Rechte zu erlangen.
Der Kernel stellt den Kern des Linux Betriebssystems dar.
Revision: Neue Updates von Oracle Linux, Ubuntu, openSUSE und SUSE aufgenommen

en.title: Linux kernel: Multiple vulnerabilities in IPv4 networking and other subsystems
en.summary: Several vulnerabilities have been discovered in the Linux kernel, allowing attackers to compromise systems, cause a denial of service, or gain root privileges.
en.impact: Attackers can potentially compromise the affected system, execute unauthorized code or commands, cause a denial of service, or escalate privileges to root.
en.fix: Apply the latest kernel updates provided by your distribution vendor.
checks: Inventory Linux systems and check the running kernel versions.
Verify whether the affected subsystems and packages (such as linux-oracle or linux-aws-fips) are deployed.
Apply vendor-provided kernel updates and reboot the system to complete the process.

ru.title: Ядро Linux: Множественные уязвимости в сетевой подсистеме IPv4 и других компонентах
ru.summary: В ядре Linux обнаружено несколько уязвимостей, позволяющих злоумышленникам скомпрометировать систему, вызвать отказ в обслуживании или получить права суперпользователя.
ru.impact: Злоумышленники могут скомпрометировать уязвимую систему, выполнить неавторизованный код или команды, вызвать отказ в обслуживании или повысить привилегии до root.
ru.fix: Установите последние обновления ядра, предоставленные разработчиком вашего дистрибутива.
checks: Проинвентаризуйте системы Linux и проверьте используемые версии ядра.
Проверьте, используются ли уязвимые подсистемы и пакеты (например, linux-oracle или linux-aws-fips).
Установите обновления ядра от производителя и перезагрузите систему для завершения процесса.

de.title: Linux-Kernel: Mehrere Schwachstellen in IPv4-Netzwerken und weiteren Subsystemen
de.summary: Im Linux-Kernel wurden mehrere Schwachstellen entdeckt, die es Angreifern ermöglichen, Systeme zu kompromittieren, Denial-of-Service-Angriffe durchzuführen oder Root-Rechte zu erlangen.
de.impact: Angreifer können das betroffene System möglicherweise kompromittieren, unautorisierten Code oder Befehle ausführen, einen Denial-of-Service verursachen oder Root-Privilegien erlangen.
de.fix: Wenden Sie die neuesten vom Distributionen-Hersteller bereitgestellten Kernel-Updates an.
checks: Inventarisieren Sie Linux-Systeme und überprüfen Sie die laufenden Kernel-Versionen.
Überprüfen Sie, ob die betroffenen Subsysteme und Pakete (wie linux-oracle oder linux-aws-fips) eingesetzt werden.
Wenden Sie die vom Hersteller bereitgestellten Kernel-Updates an und starten Sie das System neu.
